_note: Local JSON service of LLMAPIProvider for the small non-chat models (owner decision 2026-10-03: PSM and LFM). The proxy starts it (upstream smallmodels, startAtBoot) and serves it as the tiers structure and formalizer; nobody starts it by hand. CPU only (onnxruntime-node has no CUDA provider on linux-arm64); threads caps the intra-op threads of each model (inter-op 1) so the machine stays usable. Model paths are relative to this folder.
